info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Interactive Help API
info.description: The Interactive Help API provides users with timely assistance across various banking channels, enhancing customer experience and satisfaction. This endpoint allows for the retrieval of context-specific help based on user input, enabling consumers to quickly find guidance on banking products and services. Ideal for integration in customer service platforms or mobile banking applications, it serves as a critical tool for support teams and end-users seeking help. By leveraging this API, developers can enrich user interactions with intelligent assistance tailored to their needs.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific interactive help resource identified by its ID. This endpoint allows users to access contextual assistance to enhance their experience.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch interaction help details for the specific resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that you provide the necessary parameters and payload structure as defined in the corresponding schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested data.

GetInteractiveHelpByIdRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for the GET operation related to cross-channel interactive help operations. It is expected to be a string value that may represent content such as an identifier or a command.

partyId.description: Unique identifier for the party involved in the interaction.

channel.description: The channel through which the interaction occurs.

authenticationLevel.description: Level of authentication required for the interaction.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

GetInteractiveHelpByIdResponse_200.description: The response schema for the operations in the cross-channel interactive help API.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate related requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region in which the processing occurred.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer authentication method, which requires a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) to authenticate requests. The token should be included in the Authorization header as a Bearer token.
